remarks:
WELCOME HOME to YOUR Modern-Rural Retreat! Nestled on 3-acres of scenic wooded land with private clearings and trails for ATVs & hiking, this turn-key home offers a blend of outdoor adventure and modern living with so many updates throughout! 

Upon entering, be welcomed by an open-floorplan with a large dining area leading to an updated kitchen and great room. The bright kitchen features white cabinetry, granite countertops on both the island and breakfast bar, abundant storage in the pantry and comes fully-applianced with a stainless steel refrigerator, stove, dishwasher, and microwave. Great light enters through the wall of windows in the expansive Great Room, where a striking spiral staircase leads to a spacious second-floor bedroom / loft space and a new sliding glass doors ('25) opens directly to a huge back patio overlooking YOUR private backyard - ideal for outdoor entertaining & relaxing while breathing in the fresh air! 

On the first floor, also find a large bedroom w/ double-closet, updated bathroom, walk-in storage closet & quick access to the basement. 

Downstairs find ample storage space, forced-air furnace, hot water tank, sump pump, and water softener w/ filter ('23). Updated Electric Service, Panel, and Water Well Pump w/ wiring ('23). Replacement windows ('25) & Roof ('18). 

Outside appreciate the expansive, new stone driveway & fire pit area, 1-car garage w/ added 2nd garage stall for storage, new gutters and vinyl sided exterior including vapor barrier, OSB boards & insulation ('24). 

This property is great for anyone seeking an ultimate rural sanctuary with fast access to the Route 219 Expressway, meaning easy access to Springville amenities, Kissing Bridge / Ellicottville skiing & entertainment, and everything the City of Buffalo has to offer.

Shown by private appointment at select times. Please do not wait for an open house!
